decisions.reason: A newly launched handle family in a design-driven firm with long product life cycles shows no shortfall against aspirations after one year, so there is no trigger for problemistic search and it is kept.
The mitred handle family is still early in its life cycle, and a premium hardware maker's slack allows it to carry the product while results remain uncertain.
The multifunctional handle has no evidence of underperformance and extends the firm's core competence, so management keeps it pending more market results.
A single handle model adds marginal complexity, but it is too early to judge it against aspirations, so it is retained.
The FSB 1289 collection won the 2023 German Design Award and has its own web page, exceeding aspirations and signalling strategic commitment.
A finish option costs little to maintain across existing ranges and broadens the premium offering, so dropping it would release few resources.
